verdict.rationale: vLLM's docs describe continuous batching, advanced scheduling, chunked prefill, prefix caching and PagedAttention KV-memory management for handling many concurrent requests at high GPU utilization. Community users confirm continuous batching and KV caching as a production foundation, though one notes extra batching work was needed to get more performance. However, nothing shows the runtime reserving dedicated capacity for particular agents or sessions, or guaranteeing steady per-session throughput under contention. missing for 10: explicit capacity reservation or per-session/tenant isolation, documented throughput guarantees under concurrent load, independent benchmarks of steady multi-session throughput.
